title: Correlated Failures of AI Approval Monitors
abstract: arXiv:2610.29178v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Before an AI agent takes a consequential action, such as paying, messaging or changing code, several monitors check it. Their verdicts are combined by aggregating scores or by counting approvals, whatever inputs the monitors share. Monitors that share a base model or a poisoned input, however, may fail together. We borrow the fail-prone systems of distributed computing: lists of monitor sets that may fail together. A rule is safe if it executes no bad action and live if it blocks no good one. We measured twelve small open-weights monitors on payment approval under two pre-registered protocols. Without pre-registration, we also measured three closed frontier models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 4 Argon) and the open DeepSeek-V3.2. Every reliable fooling of a monitor into approving a fraud came through an evidence source and reached only that source's readers. translated_title: AI审批监视器的相关性失效
translated_abstract: 在AI智能体采取具有重大后果的行动（如付款、发送消息或修改代码）之前，会有多个监视器对其进行检查。各监视器的判定通过聚合分数或统计批准数的方式组合起来，无论它们共享了何种输入。然而，共享同一基础模型或被污染输入的监视器可能会一起失效。我们借用了分布式计算中的易故障系统概念：即可能一起失效的监视器集合的清单。如果一条规则不会执行坏行动，则称其为安全的；如果它不会阻止好行动，则称其为有效的。我们在两种预注册协议下，测量了十二个小型开源权重监视器在付款审批任务上的表现。在未预注册的条件下，我们还测量了三个闭源前沿模型（Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra、Gemini 4 Argon）以及开源的DeepSeek-V3.2。每一次可靠地诱骗监视器批准欺诈的行为都经由某个证据来源发生，并且只影响到读取该来源的监视器。而诱骗监视器阻止一笔正确的付款则取决于注入抗性……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文借用分布式计算中的“易故障系统”框架来建模AI审批监视器的相关性失效，并通过预注册实验证明：共享基础模型或同一被污染证据来源的监视器会一起失效，从而为设计既安全又不误拦好行动的多监视器聚合规则提供了实证基础。
en_tdlr: This paper borrows fail-prone systems from distributed computing to model correlated failures of AI approval monitors, and via pre-registered experiments shows that monitors sharing a base model or a poisoned evidence source can fail together, providing an empirical basis for aggregation rules that are both safe and live.
